special_situations.headline: AMS Update on acquisition
special_situations.summary: Update on ~₹1,550 Cr all-cash acquisition of 41.33% stake in Premier Explosives
special_situations.impact: ~171% of FY26 revenue (₹1,550 Cr deal vs ₹904.3 Cr FY26 consolidated revenue); also triggers mandatory open offer for additional 26%
special_situations.risk: Heavy equity dilution (11%+ share increase, ₹3,322 Cr preferential issue) and stretched valuation
special_situations.view_reasoning: Transformative defence-sector deal and revenue doubling, but stock trades at ~140-150x PE, already pricing in growth

special_situations.headline: Newspaper publication of commencement of the pre-packaged insolvency resolution process.
special_situations.summary: Newspaper publication formalizing commencement of pre-packaged insolvency process (PPIRP)
special_situations.impact: Qualitative: signals formal financial distress; no separate deal figure attached to this filing
special_situations.risk: Outcome depends on NCLT approval; equity holders face dilution/restructuring uncertainty
special_situations.view_reasoning: Company already in PPIRP with plunging profits; shareholders had approved distress restructuring plan.

special_situations.headline: Resignation of Statutory Auditor - M/S R.B. Jain & Associates
special_situations.summary: Statutory auditor resigns just ~3 months after being appointed for a 5-year term
special_situations.impact: Qualitative governance impact; no monetary figure attached
special_situations.risk: Very early exit of newly appointed auditor at a post-CIRP company is a red flag
special_situations.view_reasoning: Company has CIRP history; sudden early auditor resignation shortly after 5-year appointment warrants caution.

special_situations.summary: Revised LOA for Tarali Pumped Storage Project PMA role, correcting earlier disclosure error
special_situations.impact: ~16% of FY26 standalone revenue (₹1.66 Cr order vs ₹10.26 Cr FY26 standalone revenue)
special_situations.risk: This is a correction of a prior announcement, not a fresh incremental win
special_situations.view_reasoning: Small-cap with steady order inflow but low margins; correction reduces novelty of this specific filing.

special_situations.subcategory: Award of Order / Receipt of Order
special_situations.headline: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Receipt of Letter of Award
special_situations.summary: Won 230 MW FDRE capacity in SECI's 1 GW round-the-clock tender
special_situations.impact: 230 MW added to ~7,910 MW total portfolio (~2.9%); 25-yr PPA at ₹5.26/kWh, SCOD 24 months out — not a lump-sum order value
special_situations.risk: 24-month execution timeline; 90% peak-hour demand fulfillment ratio required
special_situations.view_reasoning: Just IPO'd at ~316x P/E with 3.77x debt-to-equity and 86% revenue concentration in two off-takers

special_situations.subcategory: Award of Order / Receipt of Order
special_situations.headline: We are pleased to inform you that the Company has been Awarded the Letter of award from the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) at Madangundi Fee Plaza.
special_situations.summary: Won ₹28.47 crore NHAI toll-collection LOA, Madangundi Fee Plaza, Jharkhand
special_situations.impact: ~4.9% of FY26 consolidated revenue (₹28.47 Cr order vs ₹579.58 Cr revenue)
special_situations.risk: One-year contract; part of a pattern of small serial NHAI wins, negative operating cashflow persists
special_situations.view_reasoning: Repeated NHAI order wins aid revenue visibility but margins volatile and operating cashflow negative

special_situations.headline: Full and Final Settlement w.r.t. Insolvency petition filed against Sherisha Solar LLP and completion of internal restructuring.
special_situations.summary: Settled Sherisha Solar LLP insolvency case for ₹16.51 Cr vs ₹33.39 Cr claim
special_situations.impact: ~23% of FY26 standalone revenue (₹16.51 Cr settlement vs ₹72.62 Cr revenue)
special_situations.risk: Net worth eroded, going-concern flag, qualified audit opinion, 42.7% promoter pledge
special_situations.view_reasoning: Resolves NCLT overhang but underlying business deeply lossmaking with going-concern doubts
